name: How can I prevent future window leaks after repairs?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future window leaks after repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future window leaks, regularly inspect your window frames and exterior caulking for cracks or deterioration, especially before rainy seasons. Ensure that weep holes in your window sills are clear of debris to allow proper drainage. Consider improving your exterior grading or drainage to direct water away from the building's foundation and windows. Professional maintenance checks can also identify potential vulnerabilities before they become major issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regularly inspect and re-caulk windows, keep weep holes clear, and improve exterior drainage. Professional maintenance can also help prevent future leaks.
